chapter: Pianists, Basie, Lil Armstrong and closing
title: Lovie Austin as rehearsal pianist
summary: Lovie Austin was before his time and later played rehearsals and dance classes for Sammy Dyer.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Did you ever know Loveie Austin?
Loveie? No, I didn't know Loveie too well, because Loveie was --
A little before my time, and then she was a rehearsal piano player around here for -- I think it was Sammy Dyer, one of them.
Right, and then she in later years -- this is how she made her living, doing the rehearsals for that, and then the dancing classes and all of this type thing. Right.
